Class LessonsLearnedList

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonsLearnedList
public class LessonsLearnedList extends Object

Title: LessonsLearnedList Class

Description: This LessonsLearnedList class stores lessons learned in the database and does all of the Create, Read, Update, and Delete (CRUD) work for lessons and their experience entries. It also keeps a list of the lessons it last loaded so a page can show them. The TP2 assignment asks for a list of all the lessons in the system (loadAll) and for smaller lists such as the lessons matching some keywords (search).

It uses the same lessonsDB and experienceDB tables as our Database class, and it has methods with the same names as the lesson methods the Role1 and Role2 home pages already call (getLessonList, getAllLessonList, addLesson, doesLessonTitleExist, updateLessonTitle, updateLessonDescription, deleteLesson, updateLessonLock, addExperience, getExperienceList). That way those pages can switch from theDatabase to this class with very few changes. The difference is that these methods check the input first and return an error message the page can show, instead of only true or false. The requirement names (C-1, C-2, ...) are explained in the LessonsLearned class.

How this class supports the Contributor User Stories:

  • C-1: create() / addLesson() add a lesson, and update(), updateLessonTitle(), updateLessonDescription(), and delete() / deleteLesson() manage it. Other roles use curatorUpdate(), curatorDelete(), and updateLessonLock().
  • C-2: getLessonList() and loadByContributor() list the contributor's lessons, and readForContributor() shows one with its locks. deleteLesson() refuses locked lessons.
  • C-3: addExperience(), getExperienceList(), readExperiences(), updateExperience(), and deleteExperience() handle experience information.
  • C-4: every contributor method checks the owner and leaves out the curator-only information, so contributors only see their own lessons.

CRUD operations:

  • Create: create, addLesson, addExperience
  • Read: read, readForContributor, getLessonList, getAllLessonList, getExperienceList, readExperiences, checkExists, doesLessonTitleExist, loadAll, loadByContributor, search
  • Update: update, updateLessonTitle, updateLessonDescription, updateExperience, and for curators curatorUpdate, updateLessonLock, setCuratorNotes, setSearchTerms, setCuratorStatistics
  • Delete: delete, deleteLesson, deleteExperience, curatorDelete

    • search

      public int search(String keywords)

      Method: int search(String keywords)

      Description: Read (V-2). Loads the lessons that match every keyword. Keywords are separated by spaces, and a lesson matches a keyword when its title, description, category, or curator search terms (CU-1) contain it, ignoring case. Each extra keyword makes the list shorter. Blank keywords load every lesson.

      Parameters:
      keywords - is one or more words separated by spaces
      Returns:
      the number of lessons loaded

    • update

      public String update(LessonsLearned lesson, String requester)

      Method: String update(LessonsLearned lesson, String requester)

      Description: Update (C-1, C-2). Saves a contributor's changes to the title, description, and category. Nothing is saved, and a message is returned, if the lesson doesn't exist, isn't the requester's, is locked, changes a locked field, isn't valid, or uses another lesson's title. The id, owner, creation date, locks, and curator information never change here.

      Parameters:
      lesson - holds the lesson's id and the new values
      requester - is the userName of the contributor making the change
      Returns:
      "" if the changes were saved, else an error message
